system.description:
You can only cast this jutsu while you have at least one active Doki.

You play a tune filling one of your Doki with rage unseen in this world and maybe the next. Their muscles bulge and they begin to attack wildly. All creatures within 10 feet of your Doki must make a Dexterity saving throw as they strike out against everything. On a failure the affected creatures are knocked Prone and take 2d12 bludgeoning damage or half as much on a success.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d12. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, you can select two Doki to originate this jutsu from. If a single creature is within the area of both Doki they make one saving throw at disadvantage, suffering the damage from only one instance. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank you can select three Doki to originate this jutsu from.
